# Approve Access Checklist: The orchestrator sees and answers every worker prompt in autonomous mode

**Purpose**: Review the requirements for who may approve what (dialog answers, commit requests, the git-guard deny), the trust in screen text and in the Codex session log, and the settings scope, before planning
**Created**: 2026-11-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `checklist` procedure based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Access: dialog answers

- [ ] CHK001 Is the dialog block defined exactly enough (first and last line, what counts as an option line) that two readers get the same hash? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it stated that `wait`, `watch` and `answer` all hash the same block, so a hash from one is valid in the other? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the result stated when two dialog titles are visible at once? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the existing refusals (persistent option, host-naming option, not blocked) kept as requirements, not only as "as today"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §US1 Scenario 4]

## Access: commit requests and the git-guard deny

- [ ] CHK005 Is it stated that the guard's deny test and the approve channel's refuse test are one and the same, with a test that fails if they drift apart? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it stated that the deny applies only to `git commit`, and which forms of `git` (path, `-C`, options before the subcommand) count as a commit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §US2 Scenario 6]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it stated that other reasons the approve channel refuses a commit (for example `cd`, `eval`, files the worker does not own) still send the question to the user, and are not changed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Is `push` staying with the user stated as a requirement with a negative test? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the deny reason text stated exactly, so a test can check it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]

## Trust in text sources

- [ ] CHK010 Is it stated that the screen is never a source for the Codex answer, also as a last fallback? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it stated how the reader makes sure the log record belongs to this review (nonce in that turn), not to an older turn or another tab in the same folder? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §US4 Scenario 2]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the wait for the log to appear bounded by the review's time budget, with the result at the limit? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Is it stated that the log file is read only, and never written or moved? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]

## Settings scope

- [ ] CHK014 Is it stated which files each scope writes, and that "not at all" writes nothing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK015 Is it stated that existing keys in a settings file are kept when the setting is added? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the "already set at any level" test for `st-update` stated, including the env var? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the removal trigger of the `st-update` step stated as a check someone can run? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009]

## Live check

- [ ] CHK018 Does the live check name the expected result of each step, and what counts as a pass for SC-001? [Measurability, Spec §FR-015, §SC-001]
